title: Excel Sheet Column Title
description: Convert an integer columnNumber to its corresponding Excel column title.
pseudocode:
1. result = []
2. while columnNumber > 0:
3.   columnNumber -= 1
4.   result.append(char(65 + (columnNumber % 26)))
5.   columnNumber //= 26
6. return reverse(result)

steps.note: Initialize result as an empty array to store column characters.
Decrement columnNumber to map 1-based index to 0-based index.
Calculate character for remainder and append to result.
Update columnNumber by integer division by 26.
Loop terminates. Return the reversed result as the final column title.
